text:
kai: Heads-up — code freeze for v2.4.0 starts in ~90m. If you need a late merge exception, drop the PR link, a one-line risk justification, and CI status. I’ll triage. ping @devops-oncall

jess: Requesting late-merge for hotfix: fixes embedding cache eviction bug seen on long sessions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5423. Small change, unit + added smoke e2e.

maria: Please add a changelog entry in changelog/2.4.0.md (one-liner + category) so I can include it in the release notes.

sam: @devops-oncall can we reserve a single canary region for validation? Prefer us-west-2 for latency tests.

devops-oncall: Oncall here — canary window available for 30m after the merge, I’ll monitor. Need a rollback script and the cherry-pick SHA in the PR description.

jess: Added changelog entry (see PR) and included cherry-pick instructions. PTAL.

jess: ```
git checkout release/2.4.0
git fetch origin && git cherry-pick -x abc1234def
# run smoke: make smoke-test-e2e
```

kai: Thanks. Add a short migration note to the PR (consumer cache key change) and mark risk as low-medium. If anything touches kv/cache layer we should run the longer perf smoke, but it looks small.

jess: Added migration note and extended smoke to include a 30s embed load loop. CI all green.

release-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: canary -> us-west-2. Auto-promote disabled; manual promote after 30m green.

ashley: Who is doing rollback if canary shows regressions? Need explicit owner + runbook link.

devops-oncall: I’ll own rollback. Steps in PR and runbook: revert the cherry-pick + run ./deploy/rollback.sh --region us-west-2. I’ll be watching and can execute within 10m of a fail signal.

maria: For release process: I will sign off on changelog finalization unless someone else wants it. Assigning to @maria for final text.

sam: ACK. jess, please ensure the changelog slug is single-line and includes the issue/PR link.

jess: Done (changelog slug: "fix(embeddings): cache eviction regression — #5423"). Merging now. :rocket:

kai: Approved by release lead. Remember to include the severity tag in the release notes: high for regressions.

release-bot: Merge completed (PR #5423). Canary deploy started to us-west-2. Logs: https://ci.redwood/12345/logs

devops-oncall: Watching canary. I’ll post status in 20m. If anything crosses error-rate + latency threshold, I’ll revert and run rollback script.

jess: Canary looks healthy at +5m: no errors, latencies within baseline. CPU minor bump but ok.

ashley: I linked rollback steps in the runbook channel and added a one-liner to ops-runbook.md.

maria: Noted — I’ll finalize changelog after 30m green check and then queue the release notes draft.

sam: Great work team. If canary stays green we plan promote at +30m.

jess: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick triage.

release-bot: Canary still running (15m). No alerts.

devops-oncall: Canary healthy at 20m. Will standby for promotion or rollback.

jess: Ready to promote when you give the thumbs.

kai: Give the thumbs. Promote when ready.

release-bot: Manual promote initiated by devops-oncall. Promotion started.

jess: Promotion succeeded. Closing the exception ticket. :tada:
